title: Spring Lamb Koftas
description: Delicious spring lamb koftas with a mix of herbs and spices. Perfect for a light spring evening.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb mince, parsley, mint, onion, garlic, breadcrumbs, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Cover the mixture with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
When ready to cook, use your hands to shape the mixture into 8-10 koftas.
Place the koftas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving a little space between each kofta.
Brush the tops of the koftas with olive oil.
Bake the koftas in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve the koftas hot with your favorite sides.
